start.title: Getting started
start.markdown: TearPDF is a locally hosted web application. Import PDFs to begin. See the [Backup guide](doc:backups) for keeping a copy of your library.

run.title: Run locally
run.markdown: Build the frontend, package the Java application, and run TearPDF.jar with Java 25. Open localhost:8080. Docker commands are in README.md.

backups.title: Backup guide
backups.markdown: Stop TearPDF and copy the entire data/library directory, including the SQLite database and immutable PDF objects. Restore the directory before restarting.
